Supply_Drop_Notifications_Description: Set the type of notifications for CH-47s. 0 = disabled. 1 = Server message prefix with coordinates. 2 = Server message prefix with location name and no coordinates. 3 = Server message prefix with location name and coordinates.
Notification_Transport_Player_Location_N: a player who requested an extraction.
Notification_Vehicle_Player_Location_Nam: a player who requested a vehicle.
Transport_Health_Description: Set the health of the Transport CH-47, values of 0 or less will make it invincible. Max health is 100000.
Transport_Volume_Description: Set the volume of the Transport CH-47, values range from 0.0 to 1.0.
Transport_Speed_Description: Set the speed of the Transport CH-47 in meters per second. Higher values can effect player safety when standing in moving helicopter as well as visual instability. Recommended to sit in a seat during flight.
Transport_Altitude_Description: Set the cruising altitude of the Transport CH-47 in meters.
Transport_Altitude_Tolerance_Description: Set the tolerance for the cruising altitude of the Transport CH-47 in meters. Lower values result in more precise altitude control, however the max speed of altitude change is set to 9m/s due to player safety.
Transport_Return_Delay_Description: Set the delay in seconds before the Transport CH-47 returns to its first location after landing and no players being nearby.
Supply_Drop_Event_Type_Description: Set the type(s) of supply drop events that are enabled. 0 = disabled. 1 = dynamic/config controlled only. 2 = player called/triggered only. 3 = both types enabled.
Disable_Vehicle_Drop_Description: Set whether or not to disable the dynamic event randomly selecting the vehicle drops instead of supply drops. Does not effect player triggered vehicle drops.
Supply_Drop_Health_Description: Set the health of the Supply Drop CH-47, values of 0 or less will make it invincible. Max health is 100000.
Supply_Drop_Volume_Description: Set the volume of the Supply Drop CH-47, values range from 0.0 to 1.0.
Supply_Drop_Speed_Description: Set the speed of the Supply Drop CH-47 in meters per second.
Supply_Drop_Altitude_Description: Set the cruising altitude of the Supply Drop CH-47 in meters.
Supply_Drop_Altitude_Tolerance_Descripti: Set the tolerance for the cruising altitude of the Supply Drop CH-47 in meters. Lower values result in more precise altitude control.
Max_Count_Of_Supply_Drops_Description: Set the maximum of supply drops allowed on the map at the same time. Counts both flying and landed supply drops.
Lifetime_Of_Supply_Drop_In_Seconds_Descr: Set the lifetime of the supply drops in seconds. This will reset each time a player is nearby the supply drop.
Delay_In_Seconds_Until_Next_Supply_Drop_: Set the min/max delay in seconds until a new supply drop event is spawned. A random time in between the min/max will be chosen each time a supply drop event is scheduled to spawn.
